# Ubiquiti

Cover UniFi gateways/switches/APs and airMAX/airFiber outdoor wireless families: NanoStation, NanoBeam, PowerBeam, LiteBeam, Rocket, and related products. Distinguish UniFi management from airOS workflows. Check exact generation, firmware, band, regulatory domain, channel width, antenna, PoE, bridge/routing mode, VLAN handling, and link metrics.
